resources.name: SCEP SPEC-013 Multi-Driver Weekly Smoke
resources.description: Prepare and validate one isolated weekly SPEC-013 run with five independent EVDriver profiles, multiple JWTs, two Stations and three Connectors.

resources.name: SPEC-013 Multi 1 - Prepare Weekly Run
resources.description: Run 01 through 24 in order. Save request 23 as bootstrap.json, copy scenario_json and simulator_env, then execute the external simulator.

resources.name: SPEC-013 Multi 2 - Verify and Complete
resources.description: Run only after the external report is FINISHED. Requests inspect activity across all dedicated Connectors and complete the run last.

resources.name: 01 - Login Bootstrap Administrator and Initialize
resources.afterResponseScript:
insomnia.test('administrator login returns 200', () => insomnia.expect(insomnia.response.code).to.eql(200));
if (insomnia.response.code === 200) insomnia.baseEnvironment.set('admin_token', insomnia.response.json().access_token);

20 - Create Weekly DRAFT SimulationRun
21 - Inspect Weekly DRAFT Run
resources.afterResponseScript:
const body=insomnia.response.json();
insomnia.test('weekly run remains DRAFT', () => { insomnia.expect(insomnia.response.code).to.eql(200); insomnia.expect(body.status).to.eql('DRAFT'); insomnia.expect(body.last_accepted_simulated_at).to.eql(null); });

resources.name: 22 - START Run and Build Five-Driver Scenario
23 - Export RUNNING Bootstrap - Save This Response
24 - Verify Weekly Run Ready
resources.afterResponseScript:
const env=insomnia.baseEnvironment; const body=insomnia.response.json();
insomnia.test('weekly run and local inputs are ready', () => { insomnia.expect(insomnia.response.code).to.eql(200); insomnia.expect(body.status).to.eql('RUNNING'); insomnia.expect(env.get('scenario_json')).to.include('driver_id'); insomnia.expect(Object.keys(JSON.parse(env.get('SIMULATION_DRIVER_TOKENS_JSON')))).to.have.length(5); insomnia.expect(env.get('bootstrap_json')).to.include('RUNNING'); });

resources.name: 25 - Verify Run Advanced and Remains RUNNING
resources.afterResponseScript:
const body=insomnia.response.json();
insomnia.test('weekly simulator advanced logical time', () => { insomnia.expect(insomnia.response.code).to.eql(200); insomnia.expect(body.status).to.eql('RUNNING'); insomnia.expect(body.last_accepted_simulated_at).to.be.a('string'); });
